pickGuide: Choose a TV guide (XMLTV or JSON, .gz allowed)

guideFormats: XMLTV (.xml, .xml.gz) and JSON guides are supported
noPlaylistsHint: Import an M3U, TXT or JSON playlist and its channels appear here by group; you can follow them like rooms.
noChannels: This playlist has no channels yet
playlistNotSynced: This playlist has not been synced yet
pickPlaylist: Choose a playlist (M3U, TXT or JSON)
userAgentEmpty: Leave empty to use the global setting
playlistUserAgentHint: Sent when downloading the list and playing its channels; a channel's own value wins

deletePlaylistConfirm(param=n).other: Delete "{name}" and its {n} channels? Followed channels stay but show "Channel not found".

title: IPTV
playlistsHint: Import M3U, TXT or JSON playlists from a file or URL; channels appear under Discover › IPTV
noGuideAdded: None yet. Import an XMLTV or JSON guide to see programmes and catch up.
autoSyncHint: Syncs due URL playlists and guides 3 seconds after start
userAgentHint: Sent when downloading playlists and guides and playing channels; a playlist's or channel's own value wins
notSyncedHint: Not synced. Tap Sync to get the channels.
xtreamHint: Enter the server address (for example http://example.com:8080), user name and password
xtreamStorageNote: The user name and password are stored encrypted on this device only; backups and sync never contain them in plain text.
backToLiveFailed: Could not go back to live; tap Retry on the video
notStarted: The programme has not started yet
noCatchUp: This programme cannot be watched again
noGuideMatch: No guide matched. Add or change a guide source and it matches automatically.
noProgrammeNow: The guide has nothing for this time yet
guideLoadFailed: Could not load the TV guide
noProgrammesHint: The guide has nothing for this channel two days either side of today.

error.noGuide: No TV guide found. Make sure it is XMLTV or JSON.
error.noChannels: No channels found. Make sure it is an M3U, TXT or JSON playlist.
error.badUrl: Enter a URL that starts with http or https
error.xtreamMissing: The sign-in of this Xtream account is missing. Delete it and sign in again.
error.notFound: Not found (404). Check that the URL still works.
error.network: Network error. Check your network or proxy and try again.
error.file: Could not read the file. Import it again.
error.notXtream: The server's reply is not an Xtream API. Check the server address.
